info.name: Recognize a single part from a camera image

params.name: count
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100)

items.docs: Analyses an image and returns the top-N most visually similar part revisions. This is a simpler, 'raw' alternative to the /detect-and-embed endpoint

params.name: partRevisionId
params.description: ID of the part revision to merge (source)

params.name: targetPartRevisionId
params.description: ID of the part revision to merge into (target)

items.docs: Merges one part revision into another, combining their properties
Validates if parts can be manufactured with specified processes and materials

params.name: targetPartRevisionId
params.description: ID of the target part revision to keep

items.docs: Resolves hash conflicts by merging duplicate part revisions into the target revision

info.name: Download part revision files as ZIP

items.docs: Downloads multiple part revision files as a single ZIP archive

info.name: Detect parts in an image and find similar part revisions per detection

params.name: count
params.description: Maximum number of similar part revisions per detection (1-100)

items.docs: Detect parts in the image and, for each detected part, returns the top-N visually similar part revisions. Bounding boxes are in original-image pixel coordinates ([x, y, width, height]) so the consumer can overlay them on the uploaded image.

params.name: filter
params.description: filter specification

params.name: page
params.description: Zero-based page index (0..N)

params.name: size
params.description: The size of the page to be returned

params.name: sort
params.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

params.name: search
params.description: Optional search term

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of part revisions with optional filtering and search

params.description: ID of the part revision to retrieve

params.name: partRevisionId
params.description: ID of the part revision to scrub

items.docs: Removes all accessory files and content-derivable signals (geometry, thumbnails, hashes, similarity vectors) for a part revision and marks it as deleted. The PartRevision row itself is preserved so inbound references (orders, cart items, etc.) remain intact; the frontend should render the deleted state from the returned DTO.
